document_notes: Page 45 of PIR contains entry 271 (Aelius Triccianus) which is highly relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus due to the explicit attestation of the governorship of Pannonia inferior as legatus Augustorum pro praetore.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as legatus Augustorum pro praetore Pannoniae inferioris.

segments.name_variants: Sic III 10644 nomina. quamquam. erasa, legi possunt ; plus minus evanida vel mutila in alus miliariis Pannoniae inferioris III 3720. 3724. 3725. 10618. 10629. 10635. 10637. 10644. 10647. 143542. Δέκκιον Τρικκιανόν Dio 78, 19, 3, ubi nomen fortasse corruptum, celerum Τρικκιανός, Recianus vila Carac. 6, 7.
segments.identification_and_sources: Miles in exercitu Pannonico et θυρωρός (ostiarius, cf. Espérandieu ILG 1, 107 = D. 9074) legati Pannoniae Dio 78, 13, 4.
segments.offices_and_career: Praefectus legionis secundae Parthicae a. 217 Caracallam in expeditionem Parthicam comitatus, conscius caedis eius vita Carac. 6, 7 (verba qui equitibus extraordinariis praeerat non ad eum, sed ad Iulium Martialem spectare vidit Domaszewski Rh. Mus. 57, 507 sq.); etiamtum sub Macrino legioni in monte Albano tendenti prae- fuit nimia severitate Dio 78, 13, 4; 79, 4, 3. A Macrino (in senatum adlectus) legatus in Pannoniam missus Dio 78, 13, 3;
segments.governorship_attestation: legatus Augustorum pro praetore Pannoniae inferioris sub Macrino et Diadumeniano miliari.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Ab Elagabalo occisus est Dio 79, 4, 8 (quae sequuntur non ad eum pertinent, cf. Boissevain in editione).

notes: Rose from the ranks (miles, ostiarius) to senatorial status under Macrinus.

entry_notes: Aelius Triccianus is a notable example of rapid social mobility under Macrinus, rising from a low-ranking soldier to a senatorial governor of Pannonia inferior.
